summary.text: Lori Houghton is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-22 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a business owner who lives in Essex Junction.

paragraphs.text: Lori Houghton was born in Washington, D.C., and lives in Essex Junction, Vermont.
She earned a B.S. in business and psychology from the University of Pittsburgh and an M.A. in organizational management from George Washington University.

Her career experience includes sales, management and leadership roles with TransUnion and LexisNexis, as well as work at her family business, and she served as a trustee of Essex Junction for eight years.
Houghton's current term began on January 4, 2023, and she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
She has served on the House Health Care Committee, as ranking member in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, and was assigned to it again in 2023-2024.
